decisions.reason: As a software-based extension of the firm's core second-channel authentication proposition, it likely remains inexpensive to maintain and strategically valuable to keep open while supporting cross-selling in the broader identity platform.
This architecture sits squarely in the firm's core cryptography and end-to-end security competence, and its stronger website prominence suggests enough promise to justify continued commitment.

Although more niche, the hardware-backed QR signature token fits regulated high-assurance use cases the firm serves, and its dedicated product presentation indicates sufficient market interest to retain the option.

After several years with only limited website visibility, this more specialized compliance suite looks less likely to deliver enough value to offset ongoing update and support costs in a portfolio with many other security options.
